description: Reviewer major issue 7a. Measured WAL held at 16 MB/s while rows-per-commit steps 1 to 1000; the controller lowers the commit rate proportionally. 16 MB/s is set by the SMALLEST batch: calibration level A07 showed the publisher tops out at 23.4 MB/s at one row per commit, so 16 MB/s is the highest rate every level in this family can actually hold with headroom for the loop to correct. It sits below the apply knee (~38 MB/s), which is deliberate - it isolates the effect of grouping from the effect of saturation.
